scope: Complete original interpolated PCM16 stereo kernel 0x4039E4: random signed accumulator contents, raw samples, fractional forward/reverse/zero steps, all batch lengths 1..65, volumes 0..32, nine master gains. Output bytes, final position and persisted last sample/filter state match. Native transactional prefetch/capacity rejection and zero-count guard. Excludes PCM8 sources and surrounding loop traversal.
